reviews.text: Phenomenal service, shows interest in you and your animal.

Mostly been very satisfied. BUT what I have witnessed is not good. They made a mistake that led to a dog ending up in an acute situation (in February/March). I don't know how they have handled this afterwards or what happened to the dog. But from the little I have observed I know that it was a beginner's mistake from Veterinarian Blom that could have catastrophic consequences, so we no longer dare to take our dog there.
Nice animal clinic with nice vets. The cat was calm, safe and happy after the visit 👍🏻 …

Among several clinics and different experiences, Blom Clinic really stood out as the best. Especially when you need information related to your pet, they give you correct information after making sure that it suits your individual situation. I had bad experiences with some other clinics who gave me incorrect information about traveling with my dog ​​outside the EU, which cost me a lot of money. In addition, I had to leave my dog ​​outside the country for four months to correct the serious mistake
Always received good help here, went to Maria's yesterday for a vaccine and my slightly anxious dog gained trust in her right away.

There are positives and negatives here.

Positive:
1. Seems like really nice people
2. Called me to follow up on how my dog was doing after the visit.
3. Close to home.

Negatives
1. When the dog was sick, we got an appointment with a different vet each time.
2. Communication in Norwegian felt weak, and at times, it was hard to understand what they meant. If it was a suggestion,  recommendation, or a must.
3. Didn't seem they understood my dogs behaviour completely.  They seemed scared when he started "talking " and "smiling". I think they thought he was showing teeth and barking at them.
4. Sometimes, it felt like they lacked competence and had to double check things on how to treat a dog with diaré and vomiting (something that is 2 most usually problems for a dog).
5. Felt a bit unprofessional as they were often late with email with my dogs treatment history, and I had to call ask for it so I could send it to my insurance.

All in all, ok vet place. It's a bit more expensive than some other mainstream vet place we used to go to before we moved.

Veterinarians who take time for the animal, listen and check the whole dog every time. They give good advice and follow up well. A very nice place to come with my dog ​​who has been afraid of the vet.. And facilitate and show understanding when the last vet appointment comes.
Great vets who helped our puppy get his baby teeth pulled. Good follow-up before and after the pull.
Bad and expensive. Low competence, poor communication, and not suitable as a conversation partner regarding animal diseases. Steer clear!

I am incredibly happy that I found Dyrlege Blom. They are neither the cheapest nor the most expensive clinics I have used, but it is not the prices per treatment that are the most important thing to me. The most important thing is that the animals are not unnecessarily overtreated and that I am well informed about the costs - and of course competent veterinarians, caregivers and assistants.

Here I do not experience that I am pushed into either unnecessary treatment of my animals or upselling. Dyrlege Blom is clear about prices before they conduct examinations, and presents several options for treatment and assessment so that I as the owner am included in the decisions.

All the employees I have met at Dyrlege Blom have been very service-minded and friendly, but I have the most experience with veterinarian Tone, whom I find to be professionally strong, transparent and calm. She caught my cat's illness during what was supposed to be a routine check-up, and the blood tests she took confirmed that she was right. Now my old cat is more alert than in a long time, and I am incredibly grateful that I will have more years with her.

Good service, skilled veterinarians, moderate prices and central location in Oslo. I hope Dyrlege Blom can continue to be an independent clinic and a counterbalance to the big chains. Use them! 😊
Helpful and nice people. I feel like my kitty is taken care of here 😻❤️ …
